changes.title: AIPAC Closes Donor Portal to Democrats Who Voted to End Aid to Israel
changes.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group appeared to be punishing Democrats it had endorsed for re-election after they voted in favor of an amendment that would have cut off U.S. aid to Israel.

changes.title: Without Platner, Maine Democrats Scramble to Keep Grassroots Energy Alive
changes.summary: Graham Platner’s campaign for Senate imploded last week. The activists who backed him are seeking a candidate to carry his populist message in the race against Republican Susan Collins.

changes.title: These AIPAC-Backed Democrats Voted to Nix Israel Aid. AIPAC Punished Them.
changes.summary: Of the 103 Democrats who voted to eliminate aid to Israel, more than a dozen had been endorsed by the pro-Israel lobbying group. AIPAC quickly closed off online donations for them.

changes.title: As competitive Senate map emerges, both Democrats and Republicans see a path to win
